findings.title: DatePicker shifts dates backward in UTC-negative timezones
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the offset adjustment before extracting the UTC ISO date, or otherwise derive the calendar date from the original UTC timestamp. Add a UTC-negative timezone regression case covering the selected value and bounds.
evidence: bokehjs/src/lib/models/widgets/date_picker.ts:68-71: value, min_date, and max_date are each passed through _unlocal_date after Date construction.
bokeh/util/serialization.py:178-184: naive Python datetimes are converted to milliseconds from the UTC epoch without applying a local timezone.

testing_gaps: The added integration coverage checks selection and server round-trip behavior but does not exercise a UTC-negative browser timezone, where the new offset subtraction shifts dates backward.

findings.title: DatePicker integration tests do not exercise the UTC+ display regression
findings.suggested_fix: Run the browser under an explicit UTC+ timezone and assert that opening the picker for the initial 2019-09-20 value shows/selects September 20 (including the input's displayed value) before changing it. Keep the existing selection round-trip checks for the selected date.

testing_gaps: Selenium/browser execution is unavailable in this run, so test behavior could not be observed directly.

findings.title: UTC− users get prior-day dates and shifted limits
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the UTC calendar day while adapting the resulting local Date for Pikaday. Avoid applying a signed timezone offset that crosses the ISO day boundary for UTC− timezones; cover values and both limits in at least one UTC− zone.
evidence: bokehjs/src/lib/models/widgets/date_picker.ts:70: minDate: this.model.min_date != null ? this._unlocal_date(new Date(this.model.min_date)) : undefined,
bokehjs/src/lib/models/widgets/date_picker.ts:71: maxDate: this.model.max_date != null ? this._unlocal_date(new Date(this.model.max_date)) : undefined,

testing_gaps: The updated integration tests assert a UTC round trip but do not exercise non-UTC− browser timezones or assert the rendered value and min/max boundaries there.
